conversation_result_card.title: DOCN Buy and Hold

strategy.raw_user_phrasing: Buy and hold DOCN from September 1, 2023 through September 9, 2026 with $1,000 starting capital, against SPY. No fees or slippage.

result_readout_content.text: This backtest shows a buy-and-hold strategy for DigitalOcean (DOCN) from September 2023 through September 2026, which grew a $1,000 starting capital to a total return of 396.26%. That outperformed the SPY benchmark by 327.27 percentage points over the same period, though the ride was rough with a maximum drawdown of 44.86%. The strategy executed only one trade during this window, meaning the entire result comes from holding the position through a single entry and exit.
